title: Arkret Authenticated Signer Resolution Evidence
description: Content-addressed immutable signer-key resolution material retained for historical verification. The evidence ref is derived from the SHA-256 digest of the complete RFC 8785 JCS object; callers never substitute a current resolver result.

signer_evidence_ref.description: ak:signer_evidence:sha256:<hex>, where hex is SHA-256(RFC8785-JCS(complete evidence object)). The embedded hex is the sole wire carrier of the evidence digest; a carrier that holds this ref MUST NOT also carry a sibling *_digest mirror of it (encoding.md 4.0.1).

service_signer_evidence.description: Retain method-native evidence and its normalized DID document together. signer_id equals authenticated_resolution.service_id. Verify the complete native history and verification_method authorization at the retained state. Durable historical evidence permits did:key or complete did:webvh history; did:web cannot prove historical signer authority. Current route cache expiry does not retroactively invalidate retained evidence. Complete canonical evidence is at most 1 MiB.

normalized_did_document.description: Exact normalized DID document whose digest and history position are authenticated by public_resolution.method_history_evidence.

principal_signer_evidence.description: attester_signer_evidence_ref resolves to a service-kind leaf that historically verifies the Station projection attestation. Current route or DID expiry is not a retrospective validity input.

account_device_signer_evidence.description: Verify the exact signed device projection and its attester closure. For ordinary publication the cache expires_at limits current-query freshness only; authorization_window and applicable generation/revocation closures govern actual authority. Preserve the full AccountId, device and signing-key binding. This evidence alone does not authorize notary or root-control actions.

account_device_control_signer_evidence.description: Portable ordinary-human Control signer root. signer_id equals account_id.principal_id; verification_method is rooted in principal_inception.did and has the exact device_id fragment. authorization_event_ref identifies the original fully signed ak.device.authorize, authorized_generation_ref and generation_event_ref identify its frozen generation, confirmation_seal_ref is the first successful confirming Seal, and pcr_genesis_event_ref plus the original signed principal_inception form the independent trust anchor. history_event_refs and history_seal_refs are UTF-8 byte-sorted, duplicate-free exact references for the minimal closed PCR prefix through confirmation_seal_ref; the objects are fetched through existing exact Event/Seal transports and are not inlined or replaced by current projections. A verifier MUST obtain every referenced object, verify the complete prefix, original possession and producer proofs, exact committed outcome and historical notary configuration, and match the derived Account/device/method/key/generation/window before accepting a generic Control Event. This branch does not authorize Data, notary, DID update, recovery-factor, SessionGrant or Signal actions. Complete canonical evidence is at most 1 MiB.

agent_signer_evidence.description: Authenticate the exact Agent Authority and Account Authority proofs and all original producer evidence recursively. Historical verification uses immutable authorization evidence and applicable closure decisions; no receiver admission signature is required.
